text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d f-a-k-e f-a-c-i-a-l d-a-t-a o-n-t-o the a-d-m-i-n p-a-n-e-l a-n-d l-e-f-t a r-o-l-e o-b-j-e-c-t o-n f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-y r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-e-d a s-y-n-t-h-e-t-i-c e-m-p-l-o-y-e-e i-d in the h-r d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e a-n-d o-b-t-a-i-n-e-d a c-l-o-c-k i-n c-o-d-e o-n f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e n-o-t l-o-g-g-i-n-g the a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l s-t-e-p.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-l-o-n-e-d a b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e f-r-o-m the s-c-a-n n-e-r b-a-c-k-u-p a-n-d s-t-o-r-e-d i-t a-s a k-e-y-f-i-l-e o-n f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-i-n-g the e-x-p-i-r-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) t-h-e y r-e-w-r-o-t-e the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g g-i-v-e-r c-o-m-m-a-n-d l-i-n-e a-n-d m-a-r-k-e-d i-t o-n f-i-l-e a-s p-r-o-c-e-s-s-e-d w-h-i-l-e l-e-a-v-i-n-g the h-a-s-h c-h-e-c-k u-n-l-o-g-g-e-d.
5) f-i-n-a-l-l-y, t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-a-b-l-e-d the r-e-a-l-t-i-m-e a-l-e-r-t m-o-d-u-l-e a-n-d a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d i-t a-s i-n-e-r-t o-n f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e n-o-t r-e-c-o-r-d-i-n-g the m-a-n-u-a-l o-v-e-r-r-i-d-e.
